articles.summary: CAMBRIDGE, Mass., April 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Prime Medicine, Inc. (Nasdaq: PRME), a biotechnology company committed to delivering a new class of differentiated one-time curative genetic therapies, today announced the appointment of Svetlana Makhni as Chief Financial Officer (CFO).
